## Refused / left as is
- Unit 1 i "where He was buried": subject unstated in Geʿez, but the capital He is the standing chronicle register and the referent is clear. Kept.
- Unit 2 አጵርጌ "apurge (?)" and ቱስሕተ "fault (?)": cannot be improved without Dillmann; hedging is correct. Kept.
- Unit 2 i "unmixed (?) and pure": agrees with house entry አክራጦስ. Kept.
- Unit 3 i "does not eat / eats" for perfect ኢበልዐ / በልዐ: generic ዘ + perfect, normal sense; l keeps the tense. Kept.
- Unit 3 i quote left open at unit end (also in l): the speech runs into unit 4; consistent in both. Kept.
- Unit 5 note "ኀተምዋ ... fem. relative because እብን is feminine": correct.
- Unit 6 ይትፌነው "odd shape (?)": already hedged; I cannot resolve it better. Kept.
- Unit 6 i "and of the Holy Spirit": ሱቱፋነ takes ለ- for the first pair, and ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ may instead belong to a doxology; reading left, flagged here only.
- Unit 7 "ለለ ፩፩ ... 'one by one' (?)": hedged in the note; i has no (?) but "each one" is the house reading for ለለ. Kept.
- Unit 8 ተዘሚሮሙ "chanting (?)": hedged, sense unresolved; "mock-song" speculation in the note left as the drafter's stated alternative.
- Unit 10 "bound loosely to the next verses": vague but harmless. Kept.
- Unit 11 አሚን "faith (?)": hedged; Dillmann needed.
- The house glossary for መንፈሰ/ቅዱሰ (construct) is not changed here; it belongs to the glossing pass.
